articles.title: Meerut Bank Manager Arrested After Alleged Assault of Blinkit Delivery Worker
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Uttar Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Meerut Bank Manager Arrested After Alleged Assault of Blinkit Delivery Worker

body.html:
A 34-year-old bank manager, Yaman Kansal, was arrested by Meerut Police after CCTV footage allegedly showed him assaulting 19-year-old Blinkit delivery worker Amit Yadav at Ganga Heights in Ganga Sagar Colony on August 14.

The delivery worker alleged he was slapped, dragged into the flat and threatened with a false molestation case over an alleged five-minute delay in delivering a grocery order.

Following social media outrage and protests by delivery agents, police registered an FIR under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). Kansal was arrested on August 15.

articles.title: Sambhal: School Porch Collapses During Independence Day Event, 8-Year-Old Boy Killed
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Uttar Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: Al-Hasan Public School in Madala Fatehpur village
articles.excerpt: Sambhal: An 8-year-old boy was killed and two others injured after a school porch reportedly collapsed under the weight of children who climbed onto it to watch an Independence Day programme at Al-Hasan Public School.

body.html:
An Independence Day celebration turned tragic in Sambhal, Uttar Pradesh, after a school porch reportedly collapsed under the weight of children who had climbed onto it to watch the programme, killing an eight-year-old boy and injuring two others.

The incident took place on Saturday morning at Al-Hasan Public School in Madala Fatehpur village, where an Independence Day programme was underway.

According to police, the flag-hoisting ceremony had concluded and students were performing when several children from nearby homes climbed onto the porch above the school's main gate to get a better view of the event.

The structure reportedly gave way under the additional weight, trapping three children beneath the debris.

The deceased was identified as Nizam, 8, son of Naeem. Two other children, Saif Ali, 11, and Shaidana, 10, sustained injuries and were taken to a hospital for treatment.

The District Magistrate and Superintendent of Police reportedly visited the site and issued necessary directions. The family of the deceased child reportedly declined a post-mortem examination.

Police said the children involved were from the surrounding neighbourhood and had come to watch the school's Independence Day celebrations.

articles.title: Kolkata: Woman Learning to Drive Dies After New Car Plunges Into Pond
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (West Bengal)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: The deceased, Sumitra Das
articles.excerpt: Kolkata: A 42-year-old corporate executive, Sumitra Das, died after a newly purchased car she was reportedly learning to drive plunged into a 10–12-ft-deep pond in Kestopur. Police suspect she may have accidentally pressed the accelerator instead of the brake.

body.html:
A 42-year-old corporate executive died after the newly purchased car she was reportedly learning to drive plunged into a pond in Kestopur, Kolkata, on Wednesday morning.

The deceased, Sumitra Das, was reportedly practising driving when the accident occurred around 7:45 am near Prafulla Kanan West, off VIP Road. Police suspect she may have accidentally pressed the accelerator instead of the brake while attempting to drive the car out of a garage.

According to neighbours, the car suddenly moved forward and plunged into a 10–12-foot-deep pond opposite the garage. Das became trapped inside the submerged vehicle.

Local residents rushed to the spot and several reportedly entered the pond in an attempt to rescue her. Police and fire brigade personnel were subsequently called, and the car was eventually pulled from the water more than 90 minutes after the accident.

Police suspect the vehicle's central locking system may have engaged after it entered the water, making it difficult for Das to escape. Her body was reportedly found in the back seat, suggesting she may have attempted to move away from the driver's seat and escape through the windows or windshield.

The family had purchased the car around two months earlier. Das was reportedly preparing for her driving test, scheduled for August 22, and had been practising regularly.

Police sent the body for post-mortem examination and have begun investigating the exact circumstances of the accident.

articles.title: Meerut: Delivery Boy Allegedly Assaulted, Locked Inside Flat After Dispute Over Order
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Uttar Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Meerut: A delivery worker was allegedly assaulted and confined inside a flat at Ganga Heights, Gangasagar, after a dispute with a customer over a delivery. A purported video of the incident has gone viral. The footage and allegations are yet to be independently verified.

body.html:
A video purportedly showing a delivery worker being assaulted and confined inside a flat at Ganga Heights in Gangasagar, Meerut, has gone viral on social media.

According to reports, the delivery boy had arrived at the residential complex in the Bhavhanpur police station area to deliver an order. The customer allegedly asked him over the phone to wait for some time, following which an argument broke out between the two.

The dispute reportedly escalated, with the customer allegedly slapping and kicking the delivery worker before locking him inside a room.

A purported three-and-a-half-minute video circulating online allegedly shows the delivery worker being kept inside the room for an extended period.

The video has triggered discussion and concern over the alleged treatment of delivery workers. The authenticity and full circumstances of the footage have not been independently verified. Further details regarding any police complaint or action are awaited.

articles.title: Vadodara: Trader’s Luxury Car Set Ablaze, ₹4.5-Crore Ponzi Scam Link Suspected
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Gujarat)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Vadodara: A trader’s expensive car was allegedly set on fire in Ajwa Road, with police suspecting a possible link to a ₹4.5-crore Ponzi scam and alleged pressure for a compromise. CCTV reportedly shows the attacker smashing the car before setting it ablaze.

body.html:
A trader’s expensive car was allegedly set on fire in Vadodara’s Ajwa Road area, with police suspecting that the incident may be connected to a ₹4.5-crore Ponzi scam and alleged pressure to settle the related case.

CCTV footage reportedly shows a person approaching the parked vehicle and smashing its windows with an iron rod before allegedly pouring petrol over the car and setting it ablaze.

Following the incident, personnel from Bapod Police Station and a Forensic Science Laboratory (FSL) team visited the spot and began collecting evidence.

Police are examining the CCTV footage to identify the accused, who is reportedly absconding.

Preliminary investigation suggests that mutual enmity arising from the financial fraud case may have triggered the alleged attack. Police are investigating whether the arson was intended to intimidate the trader or pressure him into reaching a compromise in the ₹4.5-crore case.

articles.title: Rajasthan: Students Lock School Gates Over Unsafe Buildings, Teacher Shortage
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Rajasthan)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: Government Higher Secondary School in Jodhawas village
articles.excerpt: Students and villagers locked the gates of a government school in Jodhawas, protesting dilapidated buildings, leaking roofs and teacher shortages. The school reportedly has 174 students but only 3 teachers. A roof slab also collapsed a day earlier.

body.html:
Students and villagers at the Government Higher Secondary School in Jodhawas village reportedly locked the school gates on Thursday, protesting against dilapidated buildings, leaking roofs and a severe shortage of teachers.

The school reportedly has 174 students but only three teachers, with five senior teaching positions remaining vacant.

The protest followed an incident a day earlier in which a portion of the school's roof slab reportedly collapsed, raising serious concerns about the safety of students and staff. Two other buildings on the campus have also reportedly remained unsafe for years.

Following the protest, authorities reportedly deployed seven temporary teachers and assured students and villagers that repair work would be carried out.

However, protesters are demanding permanent repairs and the appointment of regular teachers, arguing that temporary measures will not resolve the long-standing problems.

The demonstration comes days after similar student protests in Jaipur reportedly resulted in the suspension of a school principal.

articles.title: Ayodhya: Man Flung Into Air After Car Hits Him, Driver Flees; CCTV Captures Crash
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Uttar Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Ayodhya: A man was allegedly hit by a car in a shocking hit-and-run incident. CCTV reportedly shows the impact sending him several feet into the air before the driver fled the scene. His condition and further details remain unclear. Police are investigating.

body.html:
A man was allegedly hit by a car in a shocking hit-and-run incident in Ayodhya, with CCTV footage capturing the impact.

The footage reportedly shows the car striking the man with considerable force, sending him several feet into the air before he fell onto the road. The driver allegedly fled the scene immediately after the collision.

The circumstances leading up to the accident and the injured man's current condition remain unclear.

Police are expected to examine the CCTV footage to identify the vehicle and driver and determine the exact circumstances of the crash. Further details regarding the case and police action are awaited.

articles.title: Patiala: Couple Mauled by Pitbull While Visiting House, Mayor Signals Ban on Aggressive Breeds
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Punjab)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: Victim Ankit Sabharwal and his wife Shifali
articles.excerpt: A couple was seriously injured after an alleged pitbull attack at a house in Ghuman Nagar, Patiala. Shifali suffered deep bite wounds requiring surgery, while her husband Ankit was also injured while trying to save her. Police were informed.

body.html:
A couple was seriously injured after they were allegedly attacked by a pitbull while visiting a house in Ghuman Nagar, Patiala, with a property dealer.

The incident took place on Tuesday evening when Ankit Sabharwal and his wife Shifali went to inspect a house they were considering renting. According to Ankit, when the property's gate was opened, the pitbull suddenly rushed out and attacked Shifali.

The dog reportedly inflicted deep bite wounds on her arm and other parts of her body. She required surgery and is undergoing treatment at a private hospital. Ankit also suffered bite injuries to his legs and back while attempting to protect his wife.

Purported CCTV footage of the incident shows the dog attacking the couple as nearby residents rushed to their rescue. Several people carrying sticks eventually managed to pull the injured couple away from the animal.

Ankit said police had been informed and sought action against those responsible for allegedly allowing the dog to attack them.

The incident has renewed concerns over the safety of residents following dog attacks in Patiala.

Patiala Mayor Kundan Gogia said keeping aggressive dog breeds as pets would be banned in the city. He said the proposal would be discussed at a Municipal Corporation House meeting, where a special resolution could be considered.

The incident comes days after a girl was allegedly attacked by a stray dog in Guru Nanak Nagar on August 9.

articles.title: Bengaluru: Woman Killed After Bike Hits Pothole; Residents Blame Poor Roads
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Bengaluru)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: The deceased, Medha Akarsh.
articles.excerpt: A 32-year-old EPFO employee, Medha Akarsh, was killed after a motorcycle reportedly lost control while avoiding a pothole near Ananth Nagar, Bengaluru. She fell onto the road and was run over by a goods vehicle. Residents later held a candlelight protest.

body.html:
A 32-year-old woman was killed in a tragic road accident near Ananth Nagar, close to Hebbagodi in Bengaluru’s Anekal taluk, after a motorcycle reportedly lost control while trying to avoid a pothole.

The deceased, Medha Akarsh, a native of Kerala and an employee of the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), was travelling as a pillion rider with her colleague Ajay Guru when the accident occurred.

According to preliminary information, a car travelling ahead suddenly braked while attempting to avoid a pothole. The motorcycle rider reportedly lost control, causing Medha to fall onto the road. A goods vehicle approaching from behind then ran over her, resulting in fatal injuries. She died at the spot.

The accident triggered protests among local residents, who alleged that poorly maintained roads and recurring potholes in the Ananth Nagar–Electronic City corridor contributed to the tragedy.

Hundreds of residents later held a candlelight march and demanded accountability from the Chandapura Municipal Council and other authorities. Protesters alleged that repeated complaints about the condition of the roads had not resulted in adequate repairs.

Residents also accused authorities of carrying out poor-quality road work, claiming that potholes had reappeared soon after recent resurfacing. They said the road is frequently used by motorists and school buses, making its condition a serious safety concern.

Following the protest, residents said the municipal council agreed to hold an urgent meeting with officials and road contractors to discuss the road conditions.

Police inspected the accident site and registered a case. Further investigation into the circumstances of the crash is underway.

articles.title: Two Youths Killed, One Critically Injured After Electric Car Crashes Into Parked Truck in Nagpur
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Maharashtra)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: Bhowmik Larokar and Sagar Melwani, died in the crash
articles.excerpt: Two youths were killed and another seriously injured after a speeding electric car crashed into a parked truck near Bharatwada Chowk in Nagpur around 5 am. CCTV reportedly captured the car losing control before the fatal crash. Police are investigating.

body.html:
Two youths were killed and another was seriously injured after a speeding electric car crashed into a parked truck near Bharatwada Chowk under the Kalamna police station limits in Nagpur early Wednesday morning.

According to police, the three friends were reportedly travelling to attend a birthday celebration when the accident occurred at around 5 am.

CCTV footage reportedly shows the car travelling at high speed before the driver apparently lost control. The vehicle first struck the footpath and then slammed into the rear of the parked truck before overturning.

The impact badly damaged the car. Two occupants, identified as Bhowmik Larokar and Sagar Melwani, died in the crash.

The third passenger, Mihir Behar, suffered serious injuries and was rushed to a private hospital, where he is undergoing treatment.

Local residents alerted the police and helped with the rescue operation. A team from Kalamna Police Station reached the spot and began investigating the circumstances surrounding the fatal crash.

Police are examining the CCTV footage and other evidence to determine the exact cause of the accident.
